comparison.objective: Singulate three touching parcels on a continuously running conveyor before scanning; candidate commissions a compact shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests time-critical multi-object picking or repositioning on moving conveyance while keeping parcels over the belt. Candidate tests stationary precision tool use, fine rotational adjustment, locking, and iterative impact-response assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires two scan-line gaps of at least 5 cm while obeying lift-time and belt-boundary constraints. Candidate requires two safe, repeatable stops and retained adjustment; its rebound, overload, drift, and torque thresholds are not yet numeric.
comparison.reason: Moving-belt timing and multi-object singulation share no task-defining mechanism or outcome with damper adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
